mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment_record (payment_no, order_no, channel, amount, status, channel_trade_no, callback_count, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{paymentNo}, #{orderNo}, #{channel}, #{amount}, #{status}, #{channelTradeNo}, #{callbackCount}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, payment_no, order_no, channel, amount, status, channel_trade_no, callback_count, create_time, update_time FROM payment_record WHERE payment_no = #{paymentNo}
SELECT id, payment_no, order_no, channel, amount, status, channel_trade_no, callback_count, create_time, update_time FROM payment_record WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} AND status = '支付成功' LIMIT 1
SELECT id, payment_no, order_no, channel, amount, status, channel_trade_no, callback_count, create_time, update_time FROM payment_record WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} AND status = '待支付'
mapper.update: UPDATE payment_record SET status = '支付成功', channel_trade_no = #{channelTradeNo}, update_time = NOW() WHERE payment_no = #{paymentNo} AND status = '待支付'
UPDATE payment_record SET callback_count = callback_count + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE payment_no = #{paymentNo}
UPDATE payment_record SET status = '已关闭', update_time = NOW() WHERE payment_no = #{paymentNo} AND status = '待支付'
